module_desc: Convert raw materials into finished goods with manufacturing orders.
add_order_desc: Define output SKU, quantities, and raw material consumption.
edit_order_desc: Update manufacturing order details and material lines.
raw_warehouse_hint: Raw materials are consumed from this warehouse.
output_warehouse_hint: Finished goods are stored here after complete.
warehouse_required: Please select both the raw warehouse and the output warehouse.
qty_exceeds_available: Consumed qty is more than available stock in the raw warehouse.
actual_output_placeholder: Leave blank to use planned qty
confirm_reverse: Reverse this production? Finished goods will be removed and raw materials returned. This only works if the full output quantity is still unused.
cost_calculation_preview_desc: Estimated from raw qty and other costs — final cost is set on complete.
cost_calculation_preview_note: Complete deducts this quantity and costs from the batches that were taken.
not_authorized: You are not allowed to perform this action.
confirm_delete: Delete this manufacturing order? This cannot be undone.
list_empty: No production orders match your filters.
raw_materials_hint: Pick raw materials from the product catalog — their stock is deducted automatically when this order completes.
no_raw_materials: No raw materials in the catalog yet.
cost_calculation_desc: Automatically costed from the raw materials actually consumed plus any other costs entered for this batch.
cost_calculation_note: New average cost = (previous stock × previous cost + this batch's total cost) ÷ total quantity. The product's cost price is updated automatically.
other_costs_hint: Anything besides raw material — labor, electricity, packaging — added on top to get this batch's total cost.
renew_banner_desc: Completing this order consumes the held quantity and puts the output into available stock. Add parts and labor below.
